newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dollar rise will help French growth - Arthuis.
newsitem.headline: Dollar rise will help French growth - Arthuis.

text.p: French finance minister Jean Arthuis said on Thursday the dollar's rise against the French franc would clearly boost growth in France.

Speaking in a radio interview on RFI, Arthuis said that when the dollar fell 10 percent against the franc, the European Commission said it would cost France between 0.25 and 0.5 percentage points in growth.

Arthuis said he would not try and put a figure on how much the dollar's rise would now affect growth positively, "but there will clearly be additional growth linked to this parity, as long as it holds."
